original_question_en: In higher-dimensional general position, is the number of points forcing a convex subset exponential in the target size?
notes: Answer (PoZa22): ES_d(n) = 2^{o(n)} for all d >= 3, i.e. sub-exponential. Headline must quantify over all d >= 3 (Theorem 1.1 for d = 3 plus the Valtr projection monotonicity); d = 3 alone is not sufficient. Catalog marks this entry Eligible to claim: No.
